answer.summary: The infra-chaining E2E test timed out after 180s waiting for the source and result tokens to appear in the UI, so the action chain never produced visible output. The agent service started normally, and nothing in the log ties the failure to the player/user roster changes. The test has no flake history, so this is low-confidence: the log shows a timeout, not a cause, and a rerun is the cheap way to check whether it is an agent or timing problem rather than a regression.
